Prairie Light Hospice July 21, 2075
To: Medical Director, Blue Cross plan, Utilization Review Re: Member Leanord Frost Member ID BCX-4471-882-09 DOB 2/17/97 Hospice referral dated 07/19/2075
Dear reviewer,
I am writing to request authorisation for hospice care for my patient Leonard Frost, a 78 yo gentleman with non small cell lung cancer diagnosed in April 2072, now with progressive decline despite chemotherapy (cisplatin and paclitaxel) and a prognosis of less than 6 months. He has a home oxygen concentrator, serial SN-OC-5590-1142, which we ask be kept covered under the plan.
He has coronary disease with prior bypass. He is no longer able to go to the clinic. His wife, Dolores Frost, is his caregiver. Please call me with any problems on (918) 555-0160 ext 3302.
Sincerely,
Dr. Imran Qureshi, Hospice Medical Director Dictated but not read, signature stamp applied by clerk.
